# Slovenia.si

> > Slovenia.si is the official gateway to Slovenia, showcasing the nation's cultural heritage, innovation, sports excellence, and the 'I feel Slovenia' national brand.

This comprehensive platform presents Slovenia's identity through stories about its people, traditions, natural resources like beekeeping, technological innovations, and cultural achievements. The site serves as both a tourism resource and a window into Slovenian society, featuring content about everything from Paralympic athletes to UNESCO heritage projects.

## Key Topics

- I feel Slovenia brand
- Slovenian cultural heritage
- Beekeeping and apitherapy
- European Union integration
- National identity and branding
- Sports culture and excellence
- University of Ljubljana
- Ljubljana and Gorenjska regions
- COVID-19 response
- France Prešeren (national poet)
- Walk of Peace WWI heritage
- Slovenian innovation and technology
- Traditional customs and holidays
- Environmental sustainability
- Bled Strategic Forum

## National Identity and Branding

- [The green line to I feel Slovenia brand](https://slovenia.si/this-is-slovenia/the-green-line-to-i-feel-slovenia-brand): History and evolution of Slovenia's 'I feel Slovenia' national brand
- [Extremely rich cultural heritage](https://slovenia.si/art-and-cultural-heritage/extremely-rich-cultural-heritage): Overview of Slovenia's diverse cultural heritage and traditions

## Cultural Heritage and Traditions

- [Prešernov dan – poklon največjemu slovenskemu pesniku](https://slovenia.si/sl/umetnost-in-kulturna-dediscina/presernov-dan-poklon-najvecjemu-slovenskemu-pesniku): Prešeren Day celebrates poet France Prešeren and Slovenian culture
- [Ideja Pot miru/Walk of Peace izbrana za najboljši evropski projekt leta](https://slovenia.si/sl/umetnost-in-kulturna-dediscina/ideja-pot-miruwalk-of-peace-izbrana-za-najboljsi-evropski-projekt-leta): Walk of Peace WWI heritage project wins European Interreg award
- [Easter customs in Slovenia](https://slovenia.si/art-and-cultural-heritage/easter-customs-in-slovenia): Traditional Slovenian Easter customs including palm bundles and eggs
- [Nov Center Rog - prostor ustvarjalnosti in druženja](https://slovenia.si/sl/umetnost-in-kulturna-dediscina/center-rog-prostor-ustvarjalnosti-in-druzenja): Ljubljana's Center Rog creative hub and community workshop space
- [Mouses with apples](https://slovenia.si/art-and-cultural-heritage/mouses-with-apples): Traditional Slovenian carnival apple fritter dessert recipe

## Innovation and Technology

- [Izstrelitev prvih slovenskih satelitov](https://slovenia.si/sl/odlicnost/izstrelitev-prvih-slovenskih-satelitov): Launch of Slovenia's first satellites Trisat and Nemo HD via Vega rocket
- [Centenary of the University of Ljubljana](https://slovenia.si/business-and-innovation/cetenary-of-the-university-of-ljubljana): 100th anniversary of University of Ljubljana's founding milestone
- [EQUA Smart: A smart water bottle](https://slovenia.si/excellence/equa-smart-a-smart-water-bottle): Slovenian EQUA Smart sustainable water bottle with hydration tracking
- [Voluntary contact tracing app downloaded by 37,400 in first week](https://slovenia.si/inside-view/voluntary-contact-tracing-app-downloaded-by-37400-in-first-week): #OstaniZdrav COVID-19 contact tracing app launch statistics
- [Z aplikacijo na sled stikom z okuženimi](https://slovenia.si/sl/v-srediscu/z-aplikacijo-na-sled-stikom-z-okuzenimi): COVID-19 contact tracing app development at UKC Ljubljana

## Beekeeping and Natural Resources

- [Slovenian honey](https://slovenia.si/excellence/slovenian-honey): Protected Slovenian honey and Carniolan bee beekeeping tradition
- [Planting honey plants](https://slovenia.si/this-is-slovenia/planting-honey-plants): Slovenian Beekeepers' Association promotes biodiversity through honey plants
- [Apiterapija v Sloveniji - Majhna čebela in njena velika zdravilna moč](https://slovenia.si/sl/to-je-slovenija/apiterapija-v-sloveniji-majhna-cebela-in-njena-velika-zdravilna-moc): Apitherapy in Slovenia: Filip Terč's pioneering bee venom treatments

## Sports and Excellence

- [We love sports](https://slovenia.si/inside-view/we-love-sports): Sports culture in Slovenia featuring Katja Križnar and EU sport programs
- [Jernej Slivnik – para alpine skier](https://slovenia.si/excellence/jernej-slivnik): Profile of Paralympic athlete Jernej Slivnik, Slovenian monoski champion
- [The photographic perfection of Matjaž Krivic](https://slovenia.si/excellence/the-photographic-perfection-of-matjaz-krivic): Award-winning Slovenian photographer Matjaž Krivic's visual storytelling

## International Relations and EU Affairs

- [BSF – introduction to the discussion about the future of the EU](https://slovenia.si/inside-view/bsf-introduction-to-the-discussion-about-the-future-of-the-eu): Bled Strategic Forum discusses EU future and post-COVID challenges
- [24th Slovenian Diplomatic Conference](https://slovenia.si/inside-view/24th-slovenian-diplomatic-conference): Diplomatic conference at Brdo featuring Minister Logar and Mike Pompeo
